source_inventory.source_title: E.Leclerc Lescure-d'Albigeois director describes Dixell compromise after defensive changes
source_inventory.author_or_publisher: La Dépêche du Midi / Nawel Omara
source_inventory.source_platform: La Dépêche du Midi / Nawel Omara
source_inventory.evidence_status_basis: Independent local reporting of an interview, observation or industry analysis, subject to stated source limits.
source_inventory.source_context: Director Yoan Rivera identified a 4 am discovery on 13 October. The store used Dixell rather than Danfoss and had changed passwords and firewall settings following warnings the previous day. Around 250 metres of refrigerated cases and 100 metres of freezers were affected, with extensive discarded stock; exact monetary loss was not available. Recovery efforts started around 7 am. Separate reserve cold rooms and an independently operated Drive order-collection system remained operational.
